definition: the feeling of being free and held by nothing
description: A teenager in a plaid shirt leaps down a flight of stone steps outside a big brick building with both arms flung wide and his mouth open in a shout. He vaults over a metal farm gate onto a country lane at golden hour. He rides a bicycle down an empty road through open fields with both hands off the bars and his arms stretched out to the sides. At the end he stands with the bike on a grassy hilltop above a wide valley, tips his head back to the setting sun and throws his arms open.
